script.title: AT THE FOOD COURT
script.story_hook: One tray, two orders, and zero receipts.
script.intro_zh: 一個餐盤、兩份訂單，收據還不見了。
script.welcome_en: Hi, today's scene is a busy food court. Listen for fixing an order.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，今天的場景是熱鬧的美食街。留意請店家更正訂單的說法。
script.outro: That's how a wrong tray becomes the right lunch. Listen twice, then say it aloud.
script.outro_zh: 錯餐盤就這樣變成對的午餐。聽兩遍，再大聲說一次。
script.practice_intro_en: Now it's time to repeat every line.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在是逐句跟讀的時間。
script.char_a_description: a tired office man in his mid thirties with short faded black hair and light stubble, a wrinkled light blue dress shirt, a navy tie tucked in his pocket, grey slacks, and a medium build
script.char_b_description: a friendly college-age woman in her early twenties with long straight dark hair in a low ponytail, a bright red visor cap, a red-and-white striped polo shirt, a small apron, and an athletic build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh good, this is the beef noodle station, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɡʊd ðɪs ɪz ðə bif ˈnudəl ˈsteɪʃən ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，這裡是牛肉麵的攤位，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is! What can I get for you today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz wʌt kən aɪ ɡɛt fɚ ju təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯！今天想來點什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, one large beef noodle bowl, regular spice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm wʌn lɑɹdʒ bif ˈnʊdəl baʊl ˈɹɛɡjələr spaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，大碗牛肉麵，辣度跟平常一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, that'll be twelve twenty-five.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt ðæl bi twɛlv ˈtwɛnti faɪv/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，一共十二塊二十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay by card at the counter?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən aɪ peɪ baɪ kɑɹd æt ðə ˈkaʊntɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我可以在這個櫃台刷卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, tap here, and I'll call your number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ tæp hɪɹ ænd aɪl kɔl jɔɹ ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 當然，這裡感應，等等我會叫你的號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, I'm in a bit of a rush, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt aɪm ɪn ə bɪt əv ə ɹʌʃ ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 好，我趕時間，不好意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries, it's quick, five minutes tops.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɝɪz ɪs kwɪk faɪv ˈmɪnɪts ˈtɑps/
dialogue.zh: 別在意，很快，最多五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's my receipt, number thirty-one.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹz maɪ ɹɪˈsit ˈnʌmbɚ ˈθɜɾi wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 這是我的收據，三十一號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirty-one, that's you? Beef bowl, coming up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜɾi wʌn ðæts ju bif baʊl ˈkʌmɪŋ ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 三十一號，是你嗎？牛肉麵，馬上來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, that's me, thank you so much.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðæts mi θæŋk ju soʊ mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 對，就是我，太謝謝你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here you go, careful, the soup is lava.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ ju ɡoʊ ˈkɛɹfəl ðə sup ɪz ˈlɑvə/
dialogue.zh: 給您，小心拿好，湯燙得像岩漿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, this is rice. Where are my noodles?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ðɪs ɪz ɹaɪs ɛɹ ɑɹ maɪ ˈnudəlz/
dialogue.zh: 等等，這是飯啊。我的麵呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rice? Oh no, wrong tray, one second.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪs oʊ noʊ ɹɔŋ tɹeɪ wʌn ˈsɛkənd/
dialogue.zh: 飯？噢不，拿錯餐盤了，稍等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, I ordered beef noodles, not chicken rice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm aɪ ˈɔɹdɚd bif ˈnʊdəlz nɑt ˈtʃɪkən ɹaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我點的是牛肉麵，不是雞肉飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh my, you're right, the bag tag says chicken.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ maɪ jʊɹ ɹaɪt ðə bæɡ tæɡ sɛz ˈtʃɪkən/
dialogue.zh: 天，你說的沒錯，袋子吊牌寫著雞肉飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And I'm number thirty-one, look, right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd aɪm ˈnʌmbɚ ˈθɜɾi wʌn lʊk ɹaɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我是三十一號，你看，號碼就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, do you still have the receipt? That helps.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt du ju stɪl hæv ðə ɹɪˈsit ðæt hɛlps/
dialogue.zh: 對了，你的收據還帶著嗎？那會很有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, I had it... oh great, it's gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm aɪ hæd ɪt oʊ ɡɹeɪt ɪts ɡɑn/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我明明有拿...天，它不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't panic, I can look up thirty-one on screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /doʊnt ˈpænɪk aɪ kən lʊk ʌp ˈθɜɾi wʌn ɑn skrin/
dialogue.zh: 別慌，我可以直接在螢幕上查三十一號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, I tucked it somewhere while walking.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑɹi aɪ tʊkt ɪt ˈsʌmˌwɛɹ waɪl ˈwɔkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我走路時不知道把它塞到哪兒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It happens all day here, don't worry about it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈhæpənz ɔl deɪ hɪɹ doʊnt ˈwɝi əˈbaʊt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這裡一整天都常發生，別放在心上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, can the kitchen just remake the beef?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ kən ðə ˈkɪtʃən dʒʌst ˈɹiˈmeɪk ðə bif/
dialogue.zh: 那麼，廚房可以重新煮一碗牛肉麵嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, fresh bowl, five minutes, no charge.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs fɹɛʃ baʊl faɪv ˈmɪnɪts noʊ tʃɑɹdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，新的一碗，五分鐘，不收錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will I lose my place in the line, though?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl aɪ luz maɪ pleɪs ɪn ðə laɪn ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不過，我會失去排隊的位置嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, fixed orders keep your place, that's the rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ fɪkst ˈɔɹdɚz kip jɔɹ pleɪs ðæts ðə ɹul/
dialogue.zh: 不會，出錯重做的訂單保留原位，這是規定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phew. Actually... where did my chili oil go?
dialogue.phonetic: /fju ˈæktʃuəli ɛɹ dɪd maɪ ˈtʃɪli ɔɪl ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 呼。對了...我的辣椒醬包跑去哪兒了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rice came with a packet, did you see it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɹaɪs keɪm wɪð ə ˈpækət dɪd ju si ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 雞肉飯那盤附了一包醬，你有看到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, it fell out when I set the tray down.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɪt fɛl aʊt wɛn aɪ sɛt ðə tɹeɪ daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 噢，我放下餐盤的時候它掉出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me grab another, here, two fresh ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi ɡɹæb əˈnʌðɚ hɪɹ tu fɹɛʃ wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 我再拿新的給你，來，兩包剛拆的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're a lifesaver, sorry if I rushed you.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ə ˈlaɪfˌseɪvɚ ˈsɑɹi ɪf aɪ ɹʌʃt ju/
dialogue.zh: 你真是救星，抱歉剛剛我一直催你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We rush too much at noon, sorry about that.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɹʌʃ tu mʌtʃ æt nun ˈsɑɹi əˈbaʊt ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 中午我們都衝太快了，真不好意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I get it, the whole mall smells like lunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɡɛt ɪt ðə hoʊl mɔl smɛlz laɪk lʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 我懂，整個商場都是午餐的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, fried chicken dreams, every single day.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ fɹaɪd ˈtʃɪkən dɹimz ˈɛvɹi ˈsɪŋɡəl deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，炸雞之夢，一天接著一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, while I wait, can I get chopsticks?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ waɪl aɪ weɪt kən aɪ ɡɛt ˈtʃɑpˌstɪks/
dialogue.zh: 那，等待的時候可以先給我筷子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, bamboo ones or the reusable set?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs bæmˈbu wʌnz ɔɹ ðə ɹiˈjuzəbl sɛt/
dialogue.zh: 當然，要竹筷還是可重複使用的那組？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bamboo, please, and a napkin stack too.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæmˈbu pliz ænd ə ˈnæpkɪn stæk tu/
dialogue.zh: 竹筷，請，再來一疊紙巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All set. Did you want the chicken rice anyway?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl sɛt dɪd ju wɑnt ðə ˈtʃɪkən ɹaɪs ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好了。對了，那盤雞肉飯你想不想要？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, is it good? I'm always curious.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ɪz ɪt ɡʊd aɪm ˈɔlweɪz ˈkjʊɹiəs/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，好吃嗎？我這人最好奇了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free sample, try a bite, I'll wait right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹi ˈsæmpəl tɹaɪ ə baɪt aɪl weɪt ɹaɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 免費試吃，咬一口就好，我在這裡等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay... wow, that really is good.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊkeɪ waʊ ðæt ˈɹɪli ɪz ɡʊd/
dialogue.zh: 好...哇，真的很好吃耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right? Our hickory rice has fans, no joke.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt ɑɹ ˈhɪkəri ɹaɪs hæz fænz noʊ dʒoʊk/
dialogue.zh: 對吧？我們的山胡桃雞飯可是有粉絲的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, rice fans, that's a thing now.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɹaɪs fænz ðæts ə θɪŋ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，米飯的粉絲，這還真成了稱號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, we put it on the sign last month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz wi pʊt ɪt ɑn ðə saɪn læst mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 真的，上個月我們還把這句話放上招牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, tough choice, no, just the beef please.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm tɔf tʃɔɪs noʊ dʒʌst ðə bif pliz/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，好難選，不，還是只要牛肉麵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Respect, one beef noodles, coming right up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹɪˈspɛkt wʌn bif ˈnʊdəlz ˈkʌmɪŋ ɹaɪt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 佩服，一碗牛肉麵，立馬為您做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Actually, can I take the chicken bowl home too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæktʃuəli kən aɪ teɪk ðə ˈtʃɪkən baʊl hoʊm tu/
dialogue.zh: 其實，雞肉飯也可以幫我裝盒帶回家嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good move, boxed for nine, plus noodles free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd muv bɑkst fɚ naɪn plʌs ˈnʊdəlz fɹi/
dialogue.zh: 聰明，裝盒九塊，麵還不用另外加錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, my roommate will thank me twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt maɪ ˈɹumˌmeɪt wɪl θæŋk mi twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我室友一定會感謝我兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirty-one, beef noodles up, boxed chicken here!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜɾi wʌn bif ˈnʊdəlz ʌp bɑkst ˈtʃɪkən hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 三十一號，牛肉麵好了，雞飯也在這！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, that was fast, thank you, seriously.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ ðæt wəz fæst θæŋk ju ˈsɪɹiəsli/
dialogue.zh: 哇，好快，真的謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And your receipt turned up under the register.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd jɔɹ ɹɪˈsit tɜnd ʌp ˈʌndɚ ðə ˈɹɛdʒɪstɚ/
dialogue.zh: 而且你的收據在收銀機下面找到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Haha, the paper likes hidden treasure games.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɑhɑ ðə ˈpeɪpɚ laɪks ˈhɪdən ˈtɹɛʒɚ ɡeɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，這張紙最愛玩藏寶遊戲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's got attitude, just like the whole food court.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɡɑt ˈætəˌtud dʒʌst laɪk ðə hoʊl fud kɔɹt/
dialogue.zh: 它就是有個性，跟整條美食街一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, I'd say that's true, on good days.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪd seɪ ðæts tɹu ɑn ɡʊd deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我敢說，天氣好的日子確實如此。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Have a great afternoon, and enjoy the noodles.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ə ɡɹeɪt ˈæftɚˌnun ænd ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðə ˈnʊdəlz/
dialogue.zh: 祝你下午愉快，麵要慢慢享用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You too, sorry for the grumpy face earlier.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju tu ˈsɑɹi fɚ ðə ˈɡɹʌmpi feɪs ˈɝliɚ/
dialogue.zh: 你也是，抱歉我剛才擺了臭臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grumpy face? You looked hungry, that's all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɹʌmpi feɪs ju lʊkt ˈhʌŋɡi ðæts ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 臭臉？你只是餓了，就這樣而已。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, fair. See you tomorrow, lunch expert.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ fɛɹ si ju təˈmɑɹoʊ lʌntʃ ɪkˈspɝt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，說得也是。明天見，午餐專家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye thirty-one, come back hungry, chicken fan.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ˈθɜɾi wʌn kʌm bæk ˈhʌŋɡi ˈtʃɪkən fæn/
dialogue.zh: 再見三十一號，記得餓著肚子回來，雞肉飯粉絲。

script.youtube_title: 【美食街🍜】「湯燙得像岩漿」拿錯餐點又弄丟收據🤯🍚🎧｜聽完就會請店家重做｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Fixing a Wrong Food-Court Order
script.youtube_title_en: "The Soup Is Lava" — Fixing a Wrong Order at a Busy Food Court
script.youtube_description:
「小心，湯燙得像岩漿」——結果端來的是雞肉飯，收據還弄丟了，怎麼辦？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在人潮洶湧的商場美食街。

你會聽到：點餐、付款與拿收據的完整流程；發現上錯餐時怎麼有禮地更正；收據不見時請店家查號碼的說法；重做會不會失去排隊位置、醬料包掉了怎麼補；最後還多了外帶裝盒與歸還收據的暖心結局。

整段對話都是 A2 初級美式口語，語氣從著急到開心，示範怎麼把不滿說得客氣又有效。聽完你就會用：Wrong tray, one second.、Can the kitchen just remake...?、No charge、I'll wait right here。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，大聲跟著唸，下次美食街出錯你就會處理。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡請訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Careful, the soup is lava" — except the bowl on your tray is rice, and your receipt just vanished. What now? This episode is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set in a crowded mall food court.

You will hear: the full order-pay-receipt flow; politely fixing a wrong tray; asking staff to look up your number when the paper is gone; keeping your place in line for a remake; a dropped chili oil packet, a free sample, a take-out box, and a warm ending with the receipt found again.

Everything stays in A2-level American English, moving from worry to laughs — a model for complaining politely. By the end you'll own phrases like Wrong tray, one second., Can the kitchen just remake...?, and No charge.

Chapter 4 is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and be ready next time lunch goes wrong.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
在美食街點了牛肉麵，端來的卻是雞肉飯，收據還不見了，你開得了口請店家重做嗎？英文要怎麼客氣又講清楚？

這一集帶大家走進中午尖峰的美食街，從點餐、刷卡、拿收據，到上錯餐、查號碼、重做、試吃與外帶，一口氣聽完 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🍜 點餐流程：Um, one large beef noodle bowl, regular spice.
😳 更正訂單：Um, I ordered beef noodles, not chicken rice.
🧾 沒有收據：Don't panic, I can look up thirty-one on screen.
📦 加點外帶：Actually, can I take the chicken bowl home too?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 phew、oh my、no worries 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這頓午餐走一趟，下次餐點出錯，你也能笑著把它換回來。

祝你明天的午餐，第一盤就是對的。
